Commonworld's own paid check (research observation, micropay test 2026-11-01): the live 402 of https://x402.forgemesh.io/agent-fortune asked 0.005 USDC (x402 v2, scheme exact, Base, payTo 0x850363a27F0aC6fEb9C7a3eC4C1d295262dF9432); Commonworld paid it once and got a fortune plus a signed EIP-712 offer-receipt. Settlement: Base tx 0xcda4c42ef80ed80fb7762bc85f03a1a236ed04ca52daaa37e1ff9c2f41b5610f (block 53349948), 0.005 USDC to that payTo. An earlier unpaid probe of https://library.forgemesh.io/book-of-the-day (2026-10-23) showed 0.001 USDC to 0x85df5380DEbe236AD6BF49dE788243924B080267; the two observations differ in route, date, price and payout address. This is an updated observation, not a finding of wrongdoing. Quirk: the 402 is also served on GET, but the paid route is POST only (a paid GET answered 404 and was not charged).
